source_title: 'Football belongs to the fans': Ronaldo reacts after winning Ballon d’Or of All Time
source_excerpt: Cristiano Ronaldo has thanked fans around the world after his 2008 Ballon dâOr-winning season was voted the greatest in the history of the prestigious award, beating Lionel Messiâs record-breaking 2012 campaign in the inaugural Ballon dâOr of All Time (B.O.A.T.) poll.The Portuguese superstar took to social media to acknowledge the supporters who voted for him, sharing a message that placed the achievement firmly in the hands of football fans.âFootball belongs to the fans! Thank you to all the fans around the world, the Ballon DâOr of All Time is also yours,â Ronaldo wrote on X.Ronaldo's iconic 2008 season beats Messi's record-breaking yearThe B.O.A.T. poll, organised through the official Ballon dâOr platform, invited fans to choose the greatest Ballon dâOr-winning campaign of all time. Ronaldoâs first triumph, earned in 2008 after a remarkable season with Manchester United, emerged as the winner.At just 23, Ronaldo enjoyed a spectacular 2007-08 campaign, scoring 42 goals across all competitions as Manchester United won both the Premier League and the UEFA Champions League. He also finished as the leading scorer in both competitions, establishing himself as one of the world's standout players.His 2008 Ballon dâOr was the first of five he would win during his career, with subsequent triumphs coming in 2013, 2014, 2016 and 2017.Messi's extraordinary 2012 campaign finished second in the poll.
